name: Table 106: Grinding Complications
description: Rulebook Table 106 (p.626). Floor 5 (The Bubbles), Quest: Toxic Positivity Protocol — random complications for grinding Bolt Hawks and other Mobs amid the Ursine, Bune, and Rainbow Sprites near the Painbow. Note: the book's running heading for this table has no colon, "TABLE 106 GRINDING COMPLICATIONS," unlike most other tables in this cluster.

results.name: Impromptu flash-mob concert
results.description: A lone drummer stumbles through a few drum patterns before launching into an incredible drum solo. Within moments, other musicians, a singer, and even dancers join in, flash-mob style, building to a full performance like this was planned... which it absolutely wasn't. I swear.

results.name: Mysterious circular color-burst splatters
results.description: The crawlers come upon a building splattered with perfectly circular bursts of color, each radiating outward from a small untouched center about the size of a head of lettuce. The overlapping patterns suggest repeated targeted impacts. Whatever made them is either very precise or very enthusiastic.

results.name: The grieving Bune Lieutenant
results.description: A lone Bune Lieutenant sits crying and mumbling to themselves. Should the crawlers get close enough, they overhear phrases like "it didn't use to be like this..." and "She was such a kind soul once..." The moment they're noticed, the Bune snaps upright, wipes their face, and insists everything is fine.

results.name: A slain Ursine near a Bolt Hawk nest
results.description: The crawlers find a slain Ursine with every hair standing on end, bearing scorch marks and deep slashing wounds caused by talons. The Ursine got too close to one of the rare surface-bound Bolt Hawk nests, which the crawlers have now stumbled into as well. Then, half a dozen Bolt Hawks launch themselves into the air and attack.

results.name: Ursine failing to scrub off the graffiti
results.description: A group of Ursine attempt to wash the colorful marks off of one of the town buildings and a nearby statue of Dominic Hawthorne built when he was still topping the charts. Their attempts are only moderately successful: colors smear, blend, and spread, turning the entire effort into a slow-motion disaster.

results.name: Star-like lights trailing rainbows
results.description: A trio of star-like lights shoots through the sky high above, trailing translucent rainbows in their wake before disappearing into the clouds above.
